header.acquire-legend.you: You must pick a legend card
header.choose-card.you: Draw a card or play a card from the discard pile
header.choose-card.player: {player} must draw a card or play a card from the discard pile
header.place-central-cards.you: You must place your 4 central cards
header.place-discard.you: Play the card drawn or reveal a hidden card from your kingdom
header.place-discard.player: {player} must play the card drawn or reveal a hidden card from their kingdom
help.dragon.1: A dragon is domesticated if it's surrounded by 2 humans, 2 elves or 2 dwarves, otherwise it's wild.
help.dragon.1b: A maximum of 3 dragons may be domesticated per Kingdom.
help.dragon.2: A wild dragon makes the player lose its value as points.
help.dragon.3: A domesticated dragon makes the player win its value as points.
help.dragon.4: If there's only 1 dragon, its value is 3.
help.dragon.5: If there are 2 dragons, they both have a value of 5.
help.dragon.6: If there are 3 dragons or more, each of them have a value of 6.
help.portal.4foundSurroundingCardsAreAdj: The 4 cards surrounding the portal are considered adjacent.
help.linkedHumanElfCondition: A human tribe is adjacent to an elf tribe
help.linkedHumanDwarfCondition: A human tribe is adjacent to a dwarf tribe
help.allTribes.1: All tribes are present: goblin, human, elf, dwarf
help.allTribes.2: They do not need to be adjacent
help.2vs1.goblin-human.1: 2 goblin tribes are adjacent to the same human tribe
help.2vs1.goblin-human.2: or 2 human tribes are adjacent to the same goblin tribe
help.2vs1.goblin-elf.1: 2 goblin tribes are adjacent to the same elf tribe
help.2vs1.goblin-elf.2: or 2 elf tribes are adjacent to the same goblin tribe
help.2vs1.goblin-dwarf.1: 2 goblin tribes are adjacent to the same dwarf tribe
help.2vs1.goblin-dwarf.2: or 2 dwarf tribes are adjacent to the same goblin tribe
help.2vs1.elf-dwarf.1: 2 elf tribes are adjacent to the same dwarf tribe
help.2vs1.elf-dwarf.2: or 2 dwarf tribes are adjacent to the same elf tribe
tuto.goal.1: In Aetherya, you'll explore wild lands and build a Kingdom of varied Terrains, populated by many creatures and Tribes.
tuto.goal.2: Your goal is to organize the cards composing your Kingdom to gain points of Harmony.
tuto.goal.3: The player with the higher number of points of Harmony at the end of the game will be named 'Legendary Hero of Aetherya'.
tuto.board.1: Your Kingdom is composed of 16 cards.
tuto.board.2: Many of them are currently face down.
tuto.board.3: At the beginning of a true game, you are allowed to arrange your first 4 cards the way you want.
tuto.land.1: Placing tribes next to lands, you may win or lose points.
tuto.land.2: For instance, humans like plains <0/> but hate swamps <1/>.
tuto.land.3: Diagonally placed cards are not considered adjacent.
tuto.land.4: Click on the Human card to learn more
tuto.turn.2: picks the card from the discard and moves it to his/her Kingdom
tuto.turn.3: draws a card from the deck.
tuto.turn.4: The card must be either moved to his/her Kingdom or kept in the discard.
tuto.turn.5: In such case, a face down card from his/her Kingdom must be revealed.
tuto.round1.1: Move the card from the discard
tuto.round1.2: into your Kingdom at the specified location
tuto.round1.3: Your opponent chose to draw a card.
tuto.round1.4: Then he decided to replace his elf with the goblin he had just drawn.
tuto.conflict.2: For instance, elves hate <0/> goblins and <1/> dwarves.
tuto.conflict.3: If they are placed adjacently in your Kingdom, you will lose points.
tuto.conflict.4: Click on the Elf card to learn more
tuto.legend.1: Legend cards make you win points if you achieve specific conditions during the game.
tuto.legend.2: Click on a Legend card to learn more
tuto.round2.1: Move the Elf card from the discard to the location at the right of the Human card.
tuto.round3.3: Once retrieved, no other player may achieve this specific goal.
tuto.round3.4: Cautious: You may only pick one Legend card per turn.
tuto.dragon.1: Dragon cards provides points at the end of the game if domesticated.
tuto.dragon.2: To domesticate one of them, you must link it with 2 tribes of the same type.
tuto.dragon.3: Click on the Dragon card to learn more
tuto.round4.1: Draw a card moving the deck card into the discard
tuto.portal.1: Magic portals connect the 4 cards surrounding them. It creates opportunities to bring closer tribes and lands.
tuto.portal.2: Cautious: It may also create conflicts.
tuto.portal.3: Click on the Magic portal card to learn more
tuto.round5.1: Move the portal over the swamp
tuto.round6.1: The human and dwarf tribes are now adjacent, through the portal.
tuto.round8.1: If you don't like the drawn card, it's possible to keep it in the discard. In such case, you must reveal one of the face down cards of your Kingdom.
tuto.round8.2: Reveal one of the cards of your Kingdom
tuto.game.over.1: The game is over once all the cards of a player's Kingdom are revealed.
tuto.game.over.2: All face down cards of other Kingdoms are then revealed. And the scoring is performed.
tuto.reminder.1: As a reminder, you may win points
tuto.reminder.2: placing tribes next to lands they like
tuto.reminder.5: Be careful not to lose too many points due to conflicts between tribes
tuto.closure.1: It's now up to you to build this Kingdom
